description_en: Updates the DSL data of a flow version, used for updating the flow version on the canvas
description_zh: 更新流程版本DSL数据，用于画布更新流程版本
kebab_example: aliyun cams update-flow-version --flow-code 9ccc4100000000000000000000000000 --flow-version 1 --flow-view-model schema_:_namespace_:_External_,_version_:_1.0_,_copyright_:_Alibaba_Cloud_,_editor_:_H4sIAAAAAAAAA+1YbU/c00000000000000000000000_,_flow_:_triggerType_:_TriggeredByWhatsApp --remark '修复发送WhatsApp消息错误' --biz-code ALICOM_OPAAS --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateFlowVersion

parameters.help_en: The flow code. You can view the flow code on the flow editor (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page
parameters.help_zh: 流程编码。在流程编辑器 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面查看流程编码
parameters.name: flow_code

parameters.help_en: The flow version. You can click a flow name on the flow editor (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page to go to the flow editor canvas page and view the flow version
parameters.help_zh: 流程版本。在流程编辑器 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击流程名称进入流程编辑器画布界面查看流程版本
parameters.name: flow_version

parameters.help_en: The DSL data of the flow version. This is a JSON-formatted data string. You can orchestrate flow components on the flow editor canvas in advance, save the flow, and then click Settings > Export in the upper-right corner of the canvas orchestration page to export a JSON-formatted data file for viewing
parameters.help_zh: 流程版本的DSL数据。即为一段JSON格式的数据，您可提前在流程编辑器画布中编排好流程组件，保存后单击画布编排右上角设置>导出为一个JSON格式数据文件进行查看
parameters.name: flow_view_model

parameters.help_en: The business tenant code. Default value: ALICOM_OPAAS
parameters.name: biz_code

parameters.help_en: The business extension information. Default value: an empty collection
parameters.help_zh: 业务扩展信息，默认为一个空集合
parameters.name: biz_extend
